{{Quote|Do not go to the Meridian sector.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="PoT" />}}
The '''Meridian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], sandwiched between the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian]] and [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sectors]].

Planets in Meridian include [[Damonite Yors-B]], [[Durren]], [[Nim Drovis]], [[Cybloc]], [[Exodo II]], [[Ampliquen]], [[Nyemari]], [[Budpock]], [[King's Galquek]], [[Till Chorios]], [[Brachnis Chorios]], [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], [[Pedducis Chorios]], and [[Meridian]] itself. Spatial phenomena include the gas clouds of [[Odos]] and the [[Spangled Veil Nebula/Legends|Spangled Veil Nebula]].

==History==
In [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] lost his armor in the sector. While searching for it, he met [[Sheeka Tull]]. [[Bufus Ritsomas]] represented the sector in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zerex]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Adinorr]] was appointed to become the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Meridian sector.<ref name="SJ" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the most modern, architecturally sophisticated [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the sector was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anem]], the capital of Nyemari.<ref name="RF: Uprising" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles]] of the Antemeridian sector [[Battle of Nam Chorios|tried]] to take control of the Meridian sector, but was [[Invasion of the Antemeridian sector|defeated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

The sector was overrun by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] nearly [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] as they made their way through the Outer Rim toward [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />
